simple.meaning: עוּד (ʻûwd) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to duplicate or repeat ; by implication, to protest , testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass , restore (as a sort of reduplication).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 44 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 43:3. Its contexts include family, death, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עוּד (H5749).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עוּד (ʻûwd) / H5749 is traced through Genesis 43:3, Exodus 19:21, Exodus 19:23, Exodus 21:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.
